text:
ellie.peopleops: Quick heads up — received an ADA accommodation request from Jordan related to chronic back pain. They've also had a couple of on-call incidents noted in the last performance log. Want to coordinate a short-term duty reassignment + verify medical documentation. Can we sync on next steps?

jordan: Thanks for flagging. I can share a note from my physio, and I'm open to a short-term change in on-call duties. Worried about backlog though.

kevin.manager: I saw the incident notes. Jordan's been reliable overall but has had two pager misses in the last month. I'm supportive of accommodations, just want a clear plan so the team isn't overloaded.

maria.hrpartner: Proposed triage: 1) temporary light-duty for on-call (reduce night shifts) for 4 weeks, 2) ergonomic assessment + equipment, 3) collect medical note for the accommodation file. If Jordan agrees we'll set an interim plan and do a 2-week check-in.

jordan: 4 weeks sounds reasonable. I can take daytime coverage and shadow handoffs. I can upload the physio note now.

accom-bot: Hi — upload your documentation here: https://intranet.redwood/accommodations/upload. Accepted formats: pdf, jpg.

ellie.peopleops: @kevin can you confirm which shifts you'd like reassigned and to whom? We should avoid any on-call gaps. Also tagging @carol.legal for any documentation wording.

kevin.manager: I'll move Jordan off the two night blocks (Tue night, Fri night) and split them between Priya and Sam for the next 4 weeks. I'll add explicit handoff steps in the runbook.

carol.legal: Confirming we need a copy of the medical note and a short accommodation memo documenting the reasonable adjustments and review cadence. I'll draft the memo template.

maria.hrpartner: I'll create the accommodation record and schedule a recurring 2-week check-in with Jordan + Kevin. We should also request an ergonomic assessment from facilities.

jordan: Uploaded note (physio.pdf). Thanks all. Appreciate the quick coordination.

ellie.peopleops: Received — thanks Jordan. Action items: Kevin to update on-call schedule today, Maria to file accommodation record & schedule check-ins, Carol to draft memo, Facilities to do ergonomic review. Meeting to confirm: 30 mins tomorrow at 10:30am.

kevin.manager: I'll update schedules and ping Priya & Sam. Also will add a short runbook appendix for the shifted shifts.

maria.hrpartner: Calendar invite sent for tomorrow 10:30. Added agenda: duration, coverage, documentation, review criteria.

ellie.peopleops: Great. If anything changes, post here. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

kevin.manager: Thanks — rooting for Jordan to recover quickly.

jordan: Really appreciate it. I'll be online for the meeting and will keep my calendar flexible.

carol.legal: Draft memo in #people-ops/secure-drafts within the hour.

accom-bot: Reminder: accommodation docs are retained in HR records only and shared on a need-to-know basis.

ellie.peopleops: Closing thread after the meeting notes go into the record.

kevin.manager: noted.

maria.hrpartner: +1. Meeting notes will be uploaded to the case file.

jordan: Thanks again, closing on my side after the meeting.
